description.value: Chopstick Corner is a Korean fusion bistro in Surrey that blends traditional Korean culinary heritage with modern techniques. Their menu spans signature crispy Korean fried chicken, udon bowls, and classic Korean favourites, all made with fresh ingredients. A touring cyclist stopping here can expect a full sit-down restaurant experience with an emphasis on healthy, freshly prepared food.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content successfully fetched and clearly matches the OSM record: same business name, phone (604)385-6000, and address 100-2982 152 St Surrey. The site describes a Korean fusion bistro with a 'See MENU & Order' prompt and a 'Fast Order' section, confirming takeout service. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, charging) are mentioned anywhere in the website or OSM tags, so those fields remain null.
concerns: Website footer copyright reads 'Copyright © 2025 luckyhan.ca' — a different domain from chopstickcorner.ca — suggesting the site may be built and hosted under a different entity; worth confirming the URL association is correct.
Website contains two partially conflicting sets of operating hours in the footer, suggesting the site content may not be fully maintained.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate active restaurant that could serve touring cyclists for a meal, but none of the WWC required criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are confirmed from available evidence. A site visit or direct contact is needed to verify at least the minimum required criteria before including in the directory.
